Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class HybridProductionModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.HybridProductionModel
public final class HybridProductionModel extends Object
Hybrid reservoir, well and network production model: reservoir simulator results supply the depletion behaviour, NeqSim supplies the well, network and fluid response.

The model is the coupling

simulator results, reservoir-state proxy, inflow performance, lift curve and network, well operating point, molar feed.

At every time step the reservoir pressure, water cut, gas-oil ratio and productivity index of each well are read from ReservoirStateModel proxies at the current cumulative volumes. The well rates and the node pressures of the GatheringNetwork are then solved together: each well produces what its inflow performance and tubing lift curve allow against its node pressure, and the node pressures follow from the commingled rates through the branches. Finally the cumulative volumes are advanced. A well rate therefore changes when a choke, another well, the separator pressure or the routing changes, which a production profile replayed from the simulator cannot do.

Three fidelity modes share the same network and wells:

  • HybridProductionModel.Mode.SURROGATE: fast lift curves (typically VfpTableLookup) for tubing and branches.
  • HybridProductionModel.Mode.FULL_NETWORK: the reference models (live multiphase pipe and tubing models) in every iteration.
  • HybridProductionModel.Mode.HYBRID: fast lift curves that are corrected against the reference models at a fixed interval of time steps.

Optional FacilityConstraints hold wells back when the facility cannot take what the network delivers; the wells with the highest water cut or gas-oil ratio are restricted first. The model is a proxy of the simulator runs it was built from: HybridStepResult.isOutsideProxyValidity() tells when a new simulator run is needed.

    • setAllocationTieTolerance

      public HybridProductionModel setAllocationTieTolerance(double relativeTolerance)
      Sets how close the intensities of two wells must be for the wells to be held back together under a binding facility capacity. The intensity is the constrained quantity per oil volume, for example the gas-oil ratio under a gas capacity. Wells within the tolerance of the highest intensity share the restriction in proportion to their rates; with a tolerance of zero one well is restricted at a time.
      Parameters:
      relativeTolerance - relative intensity difference treated as a tie, default 0.02
      Returns:
      this model

    • allocate

      private void allocate()
      Holds wells back until the field rates fit the facility capacities. For the most utilised capacity the flowing well with the highest intensity is restricted, together with the wells whose intensity lies within the tie tolerance of it. The group is cut to a common fraction of its rates, found so that the capacity is just met with the other wells responding through the network; if closing the group is not enough it stays closed and the next group is restricted.

    • implicitEndRates

      private double[][] implicitEndRates(double[][] startRates, double dtDays)
      Finds the well rates at the end of a step that are consistent with the state they lead to (implicit Euler). The oil rate of every well is iterated with a per-well secant on the difference between the rate assumed over the step and the rate solved at the resulting state; water and gas follow the solved ratios. The cumulative volumes are left at their start-of-step values.
      Parameters:
      startRates - oil, water and gas rate in Sm3/day for each well at the start of the step
      dtDays - time step in days
      Returns:
      oil, water and gas rate in Sm3/day for each well at the end of the step
